deployment_requirement.statement: An image source, a decision that rests on its label and the cost of an error, declared by the owner.

external_referent: A public image benchmark with corruption variants (candidates: ImageNet-C style corruptions on a small public set; none chosen).

robustness.question: Does the model hold up under the damage this medium sees?
robustness.perturbation_or_signal: Blur, JPEG compression, brightness, rotation and crop at three severities.
robustness.truth: The undamaged sample and its label.
robustness.metric: Accuracy and macro F1 on damaged samples against undamaged, with an interval over samples.
robustness.acceptance_rule: Metric drop <= drop_ceiling at every severity.

drift.question: Is a change in the source noticed?
drift.perturbation_or_signal: Brightness and colour distribution shift; a class absent from training.
drift.truth: The planted change and null batches.
drift.metric: Detection rate and false alarms per 1000 null batches on input statistics and embeddings.
drift.acceptance_rule: Detection rate >= detect_floor and false alarms <= alarm_ceiling.

explanation.question: Does the explanation point at what determines the label?
explanation.perturbation_or_signal: Planted patches that determine the label.
explanation.metric: Pointing accuracy and a deletion test on the highlighted region.
explanation.acceptance_rule: Pointing accuracy >= pointing_floor and the prediction changes when the region is removed.

monitoring.question: Can the deployed model be watched with production signals?
monitoring.perturbation_or_signal: Embedding drift and per-class confidence in production.
monitoring.truth: A planted degradation at a known batch.

parameter_rule: Every null parameter is fixed by the deployment owner and written into this file before the first line of the slice is built; it is never fitted to a result.
not_claimed: any benchmark in this file has been run
a baseline linear classifier on hand-built features is a qualified model for this medium
